preconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(x) <= 200 for line in stdin.splitlines() for x in line.split() if x.isdigit())
preconditions.description: All input integers are non-negative and ≤ 200. The first line contains h, t, R (0 ≤ h, t, R ≤ 200, 0 < h + t ≤ R).

preconditions.expression: len(stdin.splitlines()) >= 4 and all(' ' in line for line in stdin.splitlines()[2:])
preconditions.description: Input has at least 4 lines: first line (h, t, R), second line (n), next n lines (head-cut rules), line after (m), next m lines (tail-cut rules).
Initial heads (h) and tails (t) are not both zero (0 < h + t).

postconditions.expression: (stdout.strip() == 'Ivan' and int(stdout.splitlines()[1]) >= 0) or (stdout.strip() == 'Zmey' and int(stdout.splitlines()[1]) >= 0) or (stdout.strip() == 'Draw')
postconditions.description: Output is either 'Ivan' followed by a non-negative integer (number of blows), 'Zmey' followed by a non-negative integer (blows before losing), or 'Draw' (infinite battle).

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'Ivan' if exists_winning_strategy(h, t, R, head_rules, tail_rules) else (stdout.strip() == 'Zmey' if no_infinite_resistance(h, t, R, head_rules, tail_rules) else stdout.strip() == 'Draw')
postconditions.description: Output is 'Ivan' if Ivan can win in finite blows with optimal strategy, 'Zmey' if Gorynych wins in finite blows no matter what, or 'Draw' if Ivan can resist indefinitely.

postconditions.expression: int(stdout.splitlines()[1]) == min_blows if stdout.strip() in ['Ivan', 'Zmey'] else True
postconditions.description: If output is 'Ivan' or 'Zmey', the second line is the minimal number of blows to achieve the outcome (win or lose).
